summary: --- name: firecrawl-scrape description: | Extract clean markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered SPAs. Use this skill whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content, says "scrape", "grab", "fetch", "pull", "get the page", "extract from this URL", or "read this webpage". Handles JS-rendered pages, multiple concurrent URLs, and returns LLM-optimized markdown. Use this instead of WebFetch for any webpage content extraction. allowed-tools: - Bash(firecrawl *) - Bash(npx firecrawl *) --- # firecrawl scrape Scrape one or more URLs. Returns clean, LLM-optimized markdown. Multiple URLs are scraped concurrently.
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
